name: garmin-mcp
description: Access your Garmin Connect data (activities, health, training, workouts, nutrition) for one or more accounts.
long_description: Before first use, log in once in a terminal with `garmin-mcp auth` (see the README). Every tool takes the account's email.

tool_profile.title: Tool profile
tool_profile.description: Limit the exposed tools: minimal, health, activities, workouts, training, nutrition or all (comma-separate to combine). Empty means all.
